title: AgentMatchRequest
description: Task-to-agent match request (PRP-70 item 3). task_text is tokenized for ranking only: it is never executed, never sent to an LLM for explanation and never stored (feedback keeps only a digest). The request carries no scope field: cloud, customer and domain scope come from the server-derived IdentityScope, so domain_id and customer_id are rejected as unknown keys. Nullable fields are optional and default to null.

task_text.description: Natural-language task description, 3 to 2000 characters. Control characters other than tab and newline are rejected. Tokenized only, never executed or stored.

context_entity_ids.description: Canonical IDs of entities the task relates to; used as graph-proximity anchors.

environment.description: Restrict candidates to one environment; null means any.
